requirement: A connection Postgres drops is logged by tracy-web's pool, never thrown, and the pool keeps answering

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: CI run 37942879853 (#1089): proxy.test.mjs red with uncaughtException 'terminating connection due to administrator command'; local stand 10/10/2026: after a disk-full Postgres PANIC tracy-web exited 1 with an unhandled 'error' event emitted on BoundPool at Client.idleListener.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0' (the database was really used). 'createPool: an idle connection the server ends is logged once, not thrown, and the pool keeps answering' is ok: after pg_terminate_backend of the pool's idle connection, no uncaughtException, exactly one '[db] a connection was dropped by the server: terminating connection due to administrator command' warning, and the next query answers 1. 'createPool: a checked-out connection the server ends between queries is logged, not thrown' is ok: no uncaughtException, at least one '[db] a connection was dropped by the server:' warning, and the pool answers after the dead client is released.
